name: editor-toolbar-dock
title: Editor Toolbar Dock
description: A compact design-tool dock on a dark canvas: a grip plus six line icons, the active one sitting on a white sliding plate. Tools show labels, grouped tools open flyouts, and the strip can be dragged to another edge.
use: A canvas or editor app needs a compact tool switcher that can be thrown out of the way.
avoid: It assumes a mouse-driven, sized canvas; edge throwing is awkward on touch and icon meaning needs a hover.
a11y: Roving focus, single-key shortcuts and menu arrow keys are handled; every button carries a label and pressed state. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A near-black bordered canvas holds a short white rounded strip near its bottom edge, made of a small grip and six dark line icons. The chosen tool sits on a white rounded plate, and a small white menu of tool names can open above it.
behaves: The white plate slides from icon to icon as tools are picked. Hovering shows a label with a shortcut, and pressing the corner of a grouped tool opens its flyout; dragging the grip carries the dock across the canvas and it snaps to the nearest edge, turning vertical on the sides.
customise: Pass a tools array of ids, labels, icons, shortcuts and nested sub-tools. The starting edge, shortcut scope, label and class names are props; plate springs and tooltip timing live in the source.
weight: moderate: A few animated buttons plus a layout spring that settles to a stop when untouched.
